root_cause: Widget::environment_scope is a lazily built LayoutBuilder whose builder closure prevalidation could not see into, so route content below the ModalRoute scope was validated only when it mounted during layout, after the outlet rebuild had applied; RouteOutlet therefore kept modal_route_scopes off by default.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/specs.rs (LayoutBuilder gains static_child: Option<Widget>); tree/widget/constructors.rs (environment_scope, shared_environment_scope and environment_boundary record their fixed child; other builders None; layout/basic/sizing_constraints.rs and tree/widget/structure.rs PartialEq updated for the field); tree/reconciliation.rs validate_widget_subtree descends into static_child with a per-entry ambient direction (a TextDirection scope provides its value, a boundary hides it, any other scope passes the parent's through); crates/incular-runtime/src/route_outlet.rs RouteOutlet::new sets modal_route_scopes: true and the setter doc is updated.
tests: existing atomicity tests outlet_rebuild_failure_consumes_nothing and outlet_failed_attempt_causes_no_side_effects pass with the scope on
harness: navigation__ (12 scenarios): 6/12 match before and after; same fields diverge in the same 6 scenarios (fade timelines, hero flights, observer_order, route_back_blocked); only the frame-3 start residual value jitters (0.0045-0.0057)
api_change: RouteOutlet publishes ModalRoute to route content by default (set_modal_route_scopes(false) restores the old behaviour). Internal WidgetKind::LayoutBuilder gains a static_child field.
limitations: Only static scopes descend; other builder output still validates when it materializes, as before. Static children are visited by prevalidation once per enclosing validation (prevalidation_visits counts them).
note: Supersedes navigation and navigation-design blocked records.

root_cause: Keyed reuse only searched the old children of the parent being reconciled; there was no tree-wide key identity, so a keyed subtree moved to another parent was unmounted and remounted.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/values.rs (new GlobalKey type with GlobalKey::new, Key::Global variant, From<GlobalKey> for Key); tree.rs (TreeError::DuplicateGlobalKey, global_keys registry field); new tree/global_keys.rs (registry of live global-keyed elements, retake_global_element that detaches the element from its parked or still-attached position, re-parents it, rebinds inherited contexts and updates it; retire_element that parks global-keyed descendants of removed subtrees and skips children another parent took over; per-transaction claim set for duplicate detection; finalize_parked_global_elements); tree/reconciliation.rs (mount_element tries a retake before mounting, update_existing claims global keys, the reconcile_children and reconcile_dynamic_children sweeps retire instead of unmount, unmount unregisters, mount/update/dynamic reconciliation run as global-key transactions, prevalidation rejects a global key used twice in one static description); tree/layout.rs (layout() unmounts parked elements nobody retook); tree/retained.rs (init, mount() finalizes); devtools.rs key display; GlobalKey exported from incular_widgets and internal.
api_change: Additive: GlobalKey, Key::Global, TreeError::DuplicateGlobalKey. Exhaustive matches on Key or TreeError outside the workspace need a new arm.
limitations: The move window is one frame: an element removed in update() stays parked until the next layout() ends, so a parked subtree keeps its focus nodes, semantics node and listeners until then. Duplicate detection is per reconciliation transaction (one update(), one mount, one builder materialization): two different builders each producing the same key in one frame move the element to the later one instead of failing. No currentState/currentContext lookup API on GlobalKey. Moves out of sliver/advanced dynamic parents drop the parallel child records but were not exercised by tests.
